notes:
Summary: Graystone LivePulse is a contact-center platform for mid-market telcos and BPOs. Primary initiative is a real-time agent-assist product that streams response suggestions and action shortcuts (create ticket, escalate, KB link) into the agent UI. They are evaluating Redwood for predictable latency under spikes and strict audit/SAML requirements.

Key quotes: "We need suggestions visible to agents within 80ms ideally; anything >200ms feels laggy." — Head of Product.

Technical requirements (as discussed):
- Workloads: streaming token-by-token suggestions for live agent UI, on-demand ticket summarization at call end, automated tool-calls for ticket create/route, periodic reranking for incident triage.
- Latency SLOs: 50-120ms token latency for suggestion path; 95th percentile target <=150ms including network.
- Throughput/scale: baseline 120 concurrent agents, peak 450 concurrent agents during campaigns; expected burst pattern (10x for short windows).
- Fallback behavior: must have automatic fallback to a lower-cost quantized variant during multi-region capacity pressure; fallback must preserve privacy (no long-term KV cache for fallback model).
- Guardrails & tool-calling: all function/tool calls require pre-check token and an explicit agent confirmation step; audit trail per tool-call saved to audit log; rate limits on automated ticket creation.
- Security: mandatory SSO/SAML, KMS-backed encryption for keys, retention controls for transcripts (30/90/365 day tiers), EU residency for customers in EU.
- Observability: token-level cost/latency breakdown, per-route dashboards, alerting on quality regressions (false-action rate >2%).

POC plan (agreed): 3-day spike POC on Redwood Dedicated pool. Redwood to configure autoscale + burst policy, streaming demo wired to agent UI, and logging to their SIEM. Success criteria: maintain suggestion latency under 150ms p95 during synthetic traffic bursts, tool-calling completes with audit entry <200ms, and no dropped sessions during 10x burst.

Notes from security call: InfoSec asked for ISO27001 evidence and a sample audit_log export. They also requested a documented SAML flow with a test IdP (okta). Shared security FAQ (drive link).

Commercial: mid-market budget; preference for annual reserved commitment if latency SLOs met. Procurement timeline: Nov 2024 (forecast).

Open questions / risks:
- How will prefix/KV caching interact with multi-tenant PII controls? (Engineering wants explicit per-customer cache segregation).
- Will fallback quantized model preserve key entity extraction accuracy for intent->tool mapping?
- Legal reviewing EU data residency contract language (possible clause edits).

Next steps (short):
- Redwood: provision POC cluster + security checklist template (Priya).
- Customer: provide test corpus (anonymized dialogs) and SAML cert from IdP.
- Schedule: POC target week of 2024-10-14.
